title: Shaft Comparison Tool
subtitle: Compare shaft characteristics and predict how a shaft change will affect your shot

modes.shotDescription: Enter your launch monitor data (ball speed, launch angle, spin)
modes.clubDescription: Enter your swing data (club speed, face angle, path)

reasons.moreDistance: This shaft should provide more distance
reasons.moreAccuracy: This shaft should improve accuracy and consistency
reasons.betterExpectedStrokes: This setup projects lower expected strokes for the same target window
reasons.betterOverall: This shaft offers improvements in both distance and accuracy
reasons.lessDistance: You may lose distance with this shaft
reasons.lessAccuracy: This shaft may reduce accuracy and consistency
reasons.worseExpectedStrokes: This setup projects higher expected strokes with wider miss cost
reasons.worseOverall: This shaft may not suit your swing as well
reasons.neutral: The differences are minimal - either shaft should work well

calibration.title: Personal Calibration
calibration.subtitle: Tune this model to your launch monitor tendencies.

fallback.title: 3D preview unavailable
fallback.description: Your browser/device blocked WebGL. The data and recommendation panel still use full calculations.
